findings.claim: At the new 96px card minimum, the BEST line (white-space: nowrap inside a card with overflow: hidden) is clipped, so a stored time loses its last digit. In 'track-select--many-cards' at 844×390 the selected Bramble Bends card reads 'BEST 0:40.3' instead of 'BEST 0:40.37'. That breaks the m:ss.cc time format (UI_RULES §4) for anyone with five or more tracks.
findings.evidence: Screenshot /inputs/screenshots/844x390/stage/track-select--many-cards.png: the first card's plate shows 'BEST 0:40.3' cut off at the card's right border. The 1440×900 screenshot of the same stage and the 844×390 start--menu screenshot (cards about 113px wide) both show 'BEST 0:40.37' in full. CSS: `.ui-track-card__best { font-variant-numeric: var(--font-numeric); white-space: nowrap; }` inside `.ui-track-card { ... min-width: calc(var(--space-s7) * 2); ... overflow: hidden; }`. The stage sets a stored best of 40370 ms for TRACKS[0], so it reproduces whenever the stage renders. AC1's test checks only that names aren't clipped, not BEST. The plan audit told the builder to leave BEST styling unchanged and record any overflow in journal/runs/2026-11-28/design-request.md. The journal isn't in this review tree, so I couldn't confirm it was recorded.
findings.suggestedFix: Per the plan audit, don't invent a new rule. Make sure journal/runs/2026-11-28/design-request.md records that 'BEST 0:40.37' is clipped to 'BEST 0:40.3' at 96px (with this screenshot), so the owner decides between wrapping, a smaller size or a wider minimum. Mention it in the PR as a known open point.

findings.claim: The card row's negative margin (-12px on every side) pushes the scroll container's clip edge 12px into the right safe-area inset. The peeking card is drawn up to 36px from the screen edge, inside the 48px / env(safe-area-inset-right) inset that UI_RULES §5 keeps clear. On a notched phone, part of the peeking card can sit under the notch.
findings.evidence: title.css: `.ui-start__select { padding: var(--space-s5) var(--safe-right) ... }` and `.ui-start__cards { margin: calc(var(--space-s3) * -1); padding: var(--space-s3); overflow-x: auto; ... }`. The row's border box, and so its clip, runs from x = 844 − 48 + 12 = 808. Screenshot /inputs/screenshots/844x390/stage/track-select--many-cards.png: RACE's right edge (the content edge) is at about x=796, but the peeking QUARRY RUN card is cut at about x=808, past RACE's edge into the inset. At 1440×900 the peeking MILL LANE card is cut at about x=1420, 20px from the edge, inside the 32px desktop margin. The S6 mockup keeps all cards inside the content edge, aligned with RACE.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the clip at the content edge on the right. Use `margin: calc(var(--space-s3) * -1) 0 calc(var(--space-s3) * -1) calc(var(--space-s3) * -1)` (no right margin) or the logical-property equivalent, so the row stops at the safe inset while still giving the shadow, lift and focus ring room on the other sides. The last card's shadow and focus ring stay visible at scroll end because the padding is unchanged.

checked.how: Opened both. Card look (dirt thumbnail, cream or mustard plate, dark-dirt locked card with cream padlock roundel, ink outline and 4px shadow) matches. The row peeks and RACE sits bottom-right as in the mockup. Found the clipped BEST (F1) and the clip edge inside the inset (F2).
The desktop row scrolls at a 139px minimum (96 × desktop-scale 1.45, per §5 ×1.45). The 4-card desktop layout is unchanged from main, every name and BEST is whole, and RACE is in place.
All four cards fit unscrolled, every name and BEST reads in full ('BRAMBLE BENDS', 'BEST 0:40.37', 'PINE RIDGE'), and the locked card is drawn as §12 says.

Read the whole diff. title.css uses only var(--space-*), --outline-*, --color-*, --shadow-*. track-card.ts builds the shake from tokens.space.s1, tokens.motion.durationMs.wipe and tokens.motion.easing.snap. No hex, rgb or font names. The only unit literal is '0px' for rest.

Keyframes translateX 0, +4, −4, +4, 0 (±space.s1, 3 swings), 250ms wipe, snap easing, no fill, and shake?.cancel() before restarting. Only transform is animated (§7), and under reducedMotion() there is no shake (§12).

[aria-disabled='true'] :hover/:active/:focus-visible keep transform none and shadow-button, and come after the hover rule at equal specificity, so they win. The Web Animation overrides transform only while it runs. Box-shadow stays at rest.
The diff adds no opacity, gradient, filter or new radius. scrollbar-width none follows §12's 'No scrollbar chrome'.
The stage's fixture names (Quarry Run, Mill Lane, Old Ford, Long Field) are uppercased by .ui-track-card__name. BEST uses the existing formatOptionalTime. No new copy appears in the shipped UI.
